title: Quails and the Plague at Kibroth-hattaavah
description: The people weep for meat, remembering the food they had in Egypt. Moses complains to the Lord about his burden, and the Lord takes some of the Spirit that was on Moses and puts it on the seventy elders, who then prophesy. Eldad and Medad also prophesy in the camp. The Lord sends quails in abundance from the sea but strikes the people with a severe plague while the meat is still between their teeth. The place is called Kibroth-hattaavah because there they buried those who gave in to their craving.
